title: Navi Chart report catalog entry
description: One full-page report template. See docs/adr/0002-catalog-as-data.md.

zh_title.description: The established Taiwan Traditional Chinese display name, preserved per docs/design-language/UNKNOWNS.md U3 so a Chinese-language delivery doesn't lose it.

common_types.description: Recommended report types / transferable scenarios. Non-binding on content type per report-catalog.md's selection principle — judge by structure, not by the industry a name suggests.

page_width.description: Fixed canvas width in px, or WxH for a locked social-card size (e.g. '1080', '600x1000').

density.description: Chart count and information density, e.g. '3 charts, medium'.

dependencies.description: Network dependency, e.g. 'web fonts' or 'Chart.js + ECharts CDN'.
